author: ahnyoung-paul
title: Debian Packages install fails - Unable to connect to azure.archive.ubuntu.com

failed_jobs.name: Debian Packages / Debian Packages
failed_jobs.symptom: apt-get install fails with 'Unable to connect to azure.archive.ubuntu.com:80' for all packages

key_errors: E: Failed to fetch http://azure.archive.ubuntu.com/ubuntu/pool/... Unable to connect to azure.archive.ubuntu.com:80:
E: Unable to fetch some archives, maybe run apt-get update or try with --fix-missing?
root_cause: The GitHub Actions runner lost network connectivity to azure.archive.ubuntu.com (Ubuntu package mirror) during the 'Install debian packages & check conflicts' step. All apt-get download requests failed with 'Unable to connect to azure.archive.ubuntu.com:80', indicating a transient network outage or Azure infrastructure issue. This is unrelated to the PR changes (GPU fix in common_utils.cpp).
reproduction_steps: N/A - transient network infrastructure issue not reproducible locally.
recommended_actions: Re-run the failed Debian Packages job.
If the failure recurs, check Azure infrastructure status for the Ubuntu package mirror.
prevention_strategies: Add retry logic for apt-get commands in CI workflows, or use a mirror fallback.
historical_context: Network connectivity failures to azure.archive.ubuntu.com are an occasional transient infrastructure issue in Azure-hosted GitHub Actions runners.
